_comment: Every external piece of software IoTSound builds on. scripts/check-deps.py reads the pinned version from the files listed in 'where' and compares it with upstream. Add an entry whenever a Dockerfile, manifest or compose file gains a new external dependency.

dependencies.name: Alpine Linux
dependencies.notes: Carries PipeWire, WirePlumber, BlueZ and bluez-alsa (apk, unpinned: they move with the Alpine release). A bump changes the audio stack: full audio regression on both device types.

dependencies.name: Debian
dependencies.notes: Named release (trixie = 13). Soloist needs glibc 2.38 or newer. ffmpeg, libpulse and the Snapcast runtime libraries come from apt, unpinned. Node and Go image tags carry the same release name: move them together.

dependencies.name: Node.js
dependencies.notes: Use even (LTS) majors only. Keep @types/node on the same major.

dependencies.name: Go toolchain
dependencies.notes: Builds the karaoke app and go-librespot. go-librespot's go.mod sets the minimum.

dependencies.name: Snapcast
dependencies.notes: Server and client must be the same version. Multiroom regression on both devices.

dependencies.name: shairport-sync
dependencies.notes: AirPlay 2. Bundles NQPTP. Test AirPlay from an Apple device, single speaker and multiroom.

dependencies.name: go-librespot
dependencies.notes: Floating on purpose: built from upstream master because Spotify changes its protocol. The pin is only a cache-bust date; bump it to pull a new build.

dependencies.name: Spotify Soloist
dependencies.notes: Never in the image. Self-updates from Spotify's CDN every 6 hours while idle; builds expire after 90 days.

dependencies.name: yt-dlp
dependencies.notes: Floating on purpose: latest at build time, and the container self-updates every 24 hours.

dependencies.name: modernc.org/sqlite
dependencies.notes: Karaoke queue database. Update with go get and go mod tidy, then test the queue survives a restart.

dependencies.name: axios
dependencies.notes: Pinned column is the locked version; package.json holds the range.

dependencies.name: balena-sdk
dependencies.notes: Pulls most of the transitive tree; the 'overrides' block in package.json exists because of it. Re-check each override on every bump and drop the ones no longer needed. Pinned column is the locked version; package.json holds the range.

dependencies.name: express
dependencies.notes: Pinned column is the locked version; package.json holds the range.

dependencies.name: TypeScript
dependencies.notes: Build only. A new major can need tsconfig or source changes. Pinned column is the locked version; package.json holds the range.

dependencies.name: support-toolkit
dependencies.notes: Debug container, only runs with LOG_LEVEL=debug. Third-party image on the latest tag.

dependencies.name: balenaOS and Supervisor
where: balenaCloud fleet, not in the repo
dependencies.notes: Updated per device from the dashboard. Check for a host OS update when a PR touches audio devices, WiFi or boot config.
